source_quality_filter: void table rows with finite r/Reff/radius; web rows with 0<z<3 and matterDens>-90
void_mapping_rule: map Pantheon zHD to low-z comoving-distance proxy r=2997.92458*zHD Mpc/h; assign nearest predeclared r-bin; use cumulative normalized Reff^3 load inside source support; set zero outside support
web_mapping_rule: assign nearest predeclared z-bin; use median matterDens per z-bin; robust-normalize using source-only 10th/90th percentiles; set zero outside source support
normalization_rule: clip every basis to [0,1] using source-only support and quantiles
notes: This transform creates source-native design columns only. It does not score an endpoint and does not use residuals.
